prompts.N01:
Use case: product-mockup. Create ONE empty retail shelf template for later controlled product insertion, landscape 4:3, frontal eye-level, geometrically clear and photographic. Input image is ONLY a material/light reference (black steel frame, light oak shelves, black ceiling and grey tile). Do not copy its oblique camera or busy room.
Subject: a freestanding-looking but physically AGAINST A PLAIN BACK WALL, two-bay shelving wall, exactly THREE vertical black posts (left, center, right), black perforated backing, simple blank black header, light oak boards. BOTH bays have EXACTLY FOUR merchandise-supporting horizontal oak shelves at the same four heights: an upper shelf under a generous display compartment, a second shelf, a third shelf, a bottom shelf. The overhead cap is distinct from the four display shelves. Four clear empty product compartments per bay, no extra thin hidden shelf. Whole unit including outer posts, top, base and feet visible, small comfortable margins, neutral floor foreground.
Normal lens, camera centered and level, verticals straight, no perspective distortion. Keep the rear wall visible at both sides and above so shelf placement is unambiguous. Bright neutral real commercial lighting, black ceiling with one or two square LED panels, not moody. No products, decorations, baskets, labels, prices, brand names, signage or people; do not include MIZAN text. One continuous photo, no diagram, no dimension annotations. Each compartment should be unobstructed and easy to mark as a polygon.
prompts.N02:
Use case: product-mockup. Generate ONE new empty hanging/stacking display template, portrait 3:4, exactly frontal and camera level. Input is ONLY the black metal/light oak material and real-store lighting reference. Do not copy its oblique framing.
Subject: ONE single-bay black pegboard display against a neutral wall, two outer uprights, one simple blank header/cap. In the UPPER TWO THIRDS there are EXACTLY THREE horizontal hanging rows with exactly FOUR separate simple metal merchandise pegs on each row. Pegs project toward camera naturally and each has a visible attachment to pegboard. Keep generous empty vertical clearance below each row for hanging packaged goods. In the LOWER THIRD there are EXACTLY TWO light oak supporting shelves, one midway through the lower third and one at the base. No extra shelves through hanging rows. Full frame with both sides, cap and feet visible, floor in front. No side bays.
Realistic black painted steel, dark perforated back, light oak boards, neutral bright retail light, grey tiled floor, black tiled ceiling. Slight real photographic texture but every structural line sharp enough to annotate. NO products, clothes, bags, decorations, prices, labels, logos, captions, people, diagram arrows or watermark. This is a clean editable EMPTY fixture, not a catalog sheet.
prompts.N03:
Use case: product-mockup. Generate ONE new empty low retail endcap fixture template, landscape 4:3. Input is only a material and setting reference. Build a compact standalone low black-steel / light-oak three-level open shelving endcap in a real store, waist-to-chest height, normal eye-level three-quarter view only about 15 degrees from frontal, no severe diagonal distortion.
EXACTLY THREE merchandise-supporting oak boards: top deck, middle shelf and bottom shelf. No extra merchandise support tier. Four simple black corner posts, stable feet, dark wire or perforated low back panel. Complete top, bottom, left and right boundaries in frame with space around. Lower shelves not hidden by the camera angle; all three supporting surfaces visibly usable. Background is quiet empty black/oak wall shelving, grey tile floor, black ceiling with square white LEDs, neutral bright commercial photography. Do not copy the tall peg fixture from the reference, no pegs on the low endcap.
NO merchandise, baskets, pots, price tags, signs, branding, people, props, measurement graphics, collage or watermark. Main goal is a stable empty geometry suitable for later product insertion.
